docs.title: 10.12.3. src/components/FenetreConfirmation.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/FenetreConfirmation.vue - la fenêtre « Êtes-vous sûr ? »
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Celle de l'exemple 12, complétée pour le clavier comme public/js/app.js
  de l'application HTML :
    - à l'ouverture, le focus va sur "Non, revenir" : un appui distrait sur
      Entrée ne supprime rien ;
    - Échap ferme la fenêtre (= Non) ;
    - Tab et Maj+Tab restent DANS la fenêtre (sinon le focus partirait sur
      la page grisée, derrière) ;
    - à la fermeture, le focus revient à l'élément qui l'avait (le bouton
      "Supprimer" cliqué, par exemple).
  "Non, revenir" plutôt qu'"Annuler" : la question est parfois « Annuler ce
  rendez-vous ? », et un bouton "Annuler" y serait ambigu.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';

const { t } = useI18n();
const { cleMessage, reponse } = useConfirmation();
const fenetre = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('fenetre');
const boutonNon = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('boutonNon');
let focusPrecedent: HTMLElement | null = null;

watch(cleMessage, async (cle, ancienne) => {
  if (cle !== null && ancienne === null) {
    focusPrecedent = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    await nextTick(); // the window is now on the page
    boutonNon.value?.focus();
  } else if (cle === null) {
    focusPrecedent?.focus();
    focusPrecedent = null;
  }
});

function clavier(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    reponse(false);
  } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && fenetre.value) {
    const boutons = [...fenetre.value.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')];
    const premier = boutons[0];
    const dernier = boutons[boutons.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === premier) {
      e.preventDefault();
      dernier?.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === dernier) {
      e.preventDefault();
      premier?.focus();
    }
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Teleport to="body">
    <div v-if="cleMessage !== null" @keydown="clavier">
      <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
      <div
        ref="fenetre"
        class="modal fade show d-block"
        tabindex="-1"
        role="alertdialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="confirmation-titre"
        aria-describedby="confirmation-message"
        @click.self="reponse(false)"
      >
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
          <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
              <h5 id="confirmation-titre" class="modal-title">{{ t('CONFIRMATION.TITLE') }}</h5>
              <button type="button" class="btn-close" :aria-label="t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA')" @click="reponse(false)"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
              <p id="confirmation-message" class="mb-0">{{ t(cleMessage) }}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
              <button ref="boutonNon" type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" @click="reponse(false)">{{ t('CONFIRMATION.NO') }}</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" @click="reponse(true)">{{ t('CONFIRMATION.YES') }}</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </Teleport>
</template>

The window from Example 12, enhanced for keyboard navigation using the [public/js/app.js] script from the HTML application:

  • lines 29–38: Upon opening, the element that had focus (the “Delete” button that was clicked, for example) is retained, then focus is given to the “No” button; upon closing, focus is returned to the retained element. A user navigating with the keyboard thus regains their position on the page;
  • lines 40–55: Esc is treated as “No”; Tab and Shift+Tab remain within the window: when reaching the last button, Tab returns to the first one (otherwise, focus would move to the grayed-out page behind it);
  • line 60: Keyboard input is handled by the window itself: no need to attach or detach a listener to the document;
  • line 68: for screen readers, the window’s title and message;
  • line 79: the message, translated.

docs.title: 10.12.4. src/components/ChampSaisie.vue
docs.text:
A complete form field, reused by all forms in the application:

<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/ChampSaisie.vue - un champ de formulaire complet
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Libellé + champ + message d'aide OU message d'erreur, avec v-model (cf.
  exemple 08). Tous les formulaires de l'application l'utilisent :

    <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.nom" id="nom" libelle="PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL"
                 :erreur="erreurs.nom" :params="params" :maxlength="20" />

  libelle, aide et erreur sont des CLÉS de traduction. Une erreur encadre le
  champ de rouge (classe Bootstrap is-invalid) et remplace l'aide.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';

const modele = defineModel<string>({ required: true });

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    id: string;
    libelle: string;
    type?: 'text' | 'password';
    erreur?: string; // error message key for this field
    params?: Record<string, string>; // message parameters ({min}...)
    aide?: string; // help message key
    maxlength?: number;
    autocomplete?: string;
    requis?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { type: 'text', erreur: undefined, params: () => ({}), aide: undefined, maxlength: undefined, autocomplete: 'off', requis: false },
);

const { t } = useI18n();
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <label class="form-label" :for="id">{{ t(libelle) }}</label>
    <input
      :id="id"
      v-model="modele"
      :type="type"
      class="form-control"
      :class="{ 'is-invalid': erreur }"
      :maxlength="maxlength"
      :autocomplete="autocomplete"
      :required="requis"
      :aria-invalid="erreur ? 'true' : undefined"
      :aria-describedby="`${id}-message`"
    >
    <div v-if="erreur" :id="`${id}-message`" class="invalid-feedback">{{ t(erreur, params) }}</div>
    <div v-else-if="aide" :id="`${id}-message`" class="form-text">{{ t(aide, params) }}</div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 18: the field is used with [v-model] (see example 08);
  • lines 20–33: the props: the field ID, and the CLÉS translation codes for the label, tooltip, and error message;
  • line 46: an error highlights the field in red;
  • line 51: the help or error message is associated with the field for screen readers;
  • lines 53–54: the error message REMPLACE and the help text.

When placed within a parent, the component also inherits the attributes passed down from the parent, even if they are not props: [<ChampSaisie class="col-sm-6" ...>] adds the class [col-sm-6] to its root element, [<div>] (these are known as “inherited” attributes, [fallthrough attributes]).

docs.title: 10.12.5. src/components/ChampsPersonne.vue
docs.text:
The title, first name, and last name are common to three forms:

<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/ChampsPersonne.vue - titre, prénom, nom
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Les champs d'identité, communs à trois formulaires : médecin / client de
  l'ADMIN, "Créer un compte client" et "Gérer mon compte" (l'équivalent du
  partiel views/partials/champsPersonne.hbs). Trois v-model nommés :
      <ChampsPersonne v-model:titre="s.titre" v-model:prenom="s.prenom"
                      v-model:nom="s.nom" :erreurs="erreurs" />
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import ChampSaisie from './ChampSaisie.vue';

const titre = defineModel<string>('titre', { required: true });
const prenom = defineModel<string>('prenom', { required: true });
const nom = defineModel<string>('nom', { required: true });
defineProps<{ erreurs: Record<string, string> }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const TITRES = ['Mr', 'Mme', 'Melle'];
</script>

<template>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="titre">{{ t('PERSONNES.TITLE_LABEL') }}</label>
    <select id="titre" v-model="titre" class="form-select" :class="{ 'is-invalid': erreurs.titre }">
      <option v-for="tt in TITRES" :key="tt" :value="tt">{{ tt }}</option>
    </select>
    <div v-if="erreurs.titre" class="invalid-feedback">{{ t(erreurs.titre) }}</div>
  </div>
  <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
    <ChampSaisie v-model="prenom" class="col-sm-6" id="prenom" libelle="PERSONNES.FIRSTNAME_LABEL" :erreur="erreurs.prenom" :maxlength="20" requis />
    <ChampSaisie v-model="nom" class="col-sm-6" id="nom" libelle="PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL" :erreur="erreurs.nom" :maxlength="20" requis />
  </div>
</template>
  • Lines 16–18: three [v-model] fields named: the parent writes [v-model:titre="..."], [v-model:prenom="..."], [v-model:nom="..."];
  • line 34: both text fields are [ChampSaisie]. [prenom] is the [ref] of [defineModel]: the parent-child chain -> ChampsPersonne -> ChampSaisie -> [<input>] works both ways.

A component can have multiple root elements (here, the [<div>] for the title and the row containing the two fields): this is referred to as a “fragment.”

docs.title: 10.12.6. src/components/ChampCaptcha.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/ChampCaptcha.vue - l'image du captcha et le champ de saisie
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Charge un captcha (GET /api/captcha) à l'affichage. Le parent récupère
  la saisie par v-model, et l'identifiant du captcha par la méthode exposée
  captchaId() ; il appelle recharger() après chaque tentative, car une
  image ne sert qu'UNE fois (le serveur l'oublie dès qu'il l'a vérifiée).

  defineExpose : ce qu'un composant PARENT peut appeler sur ce composant,
  grâce à une référence de template (cf. ConnexionView.vue).

  v-html : l'image SVG est insérée telle quelle. Sans danger ICI parce
  qu'elle est fabriquée par notre serveur (bibliothèque svg-captcha) et ne
  contient rien qui vienne d'un utilisateur - cf. exemple 17.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Captcha } from '../api/types';

const saisie = defineModel<string>({ required: true });
defineProps<{ erreur?: string }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const captcha = ref<Captcha | null>(null);

async function recharger(): Promise<void> {
  saisie.value = '';
  try {
    captcha.value = await rdvApi.captcha();
  } catch {
    captcha.value = null; // Server unreachable: the connection will fail with a plaintext message
  }
}

defineExpose({ recharger, captchaId: () => captcha.value?.id ?? '' });
onMounted(recharger);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="mb-3">
    <label class="form-label" for="captcha">{{ t('CAPTCHA.LABEL') }}</label>
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
      <div class="captcha-image" role="img" :aria-label="t('CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT')" v-html="captcha?.svg ?? ''"></div>
      <a href="#" class="small" @click.prevent="recharger">{{ t('CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE') }}</a>
    </div>
    <input id="captcha" v-model="saisie" type="text" maxlength="10" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"
           class="form-control" :class="{ 'is-invalid': erreur }">
    <div v-if="erreur" class="invalid-feedback">{{ t(erreur) }}</div>
    <div v-else class="form-text">{{ t('CAPTCHA.HELP') }}</div>
  </div>
</template>
  • lines 30–37: a new CAPTCHA; the previous input is cleared;
  • line 39: what PARENT can call on this component, via a template reference (see [ConnexionView.vue]). Without [defineExpose], a [<script setup>] component exposes nothing;
  • Line 47: The image SVG, inserted as-is: it comes from our server (see Example 17).

docs.title: 10.12.7. src/components/FenetreReservation.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  components/FenetreReservation.vue - la fenêtre de réservation d'un créneau
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Même fenêtre que views/partials/reservation.hbs de l'application HTML
  (et que le composant booking-dialog du client Angular) : les classes
  Bootstrap d'une fenêtre modale, affichées "en dur" (show d-block).

  Le composant ne parle pas au serveur : il émet
    - 'confirmer' avec le patient choisi (null pour un patient qui réserve
      pour lui-même) ;
    - 'fermer'.
  C'est la page de l'agenda qui décide quoi en faire (AgendaView.vue).
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import type { Personne } from '../api/types';
import { libelle } from '../composables/useFormatage';

const props = defineProps<{
  horaire: string; // "8:00 - 8:20"
  clients: Personne[]; // ADMIN / DOCTOR: patients to choose from
  patient: string | null; // USER: The patient is the patient themselves
  envoiEnCours: boolean;
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{ confirmer: [idClient: number | null]; fermer: [] }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const idClient = ref<number | null>(null);
const liste = useTemplateRef<HTMLSelectElement>('liste');
const boutonConfirmer = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('boutonConfirmer');

function echap(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    emit('fermer');
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
   // Focus on the first usable element in the window
  (props.patient === null ? liste.value : boutonConfirmer.value)?.focus();
  document.addEventListener('keydown', echap);
});
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener('keydown', echap));
</script>

<template>
  <Teleport to="body">
    <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
    <div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="titre-reservation"
         @click.self="emit('fermer')">
      <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
        <form class="modal-content" @submit.prevent="emit('confirmer', idClient)">
          <div class="modal-header">
            <h5 id="titre-reservation" class="modal-title">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE') }}</h5>
            <button type="button" class="btn-close" :aria-label="t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA')" @click="emit('fermer')"></button>
          </div>

          <div class="modal-body">
            <p>{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT', { horaire }) }}</p>
             <!-- A patient makes a reservation for themselves: no list (and the server
                 ignorerait de toute façon un éventuel idClient) -->
            <p v-if="patient !== null" class="mb-0">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL') }} : <strong>{{ patient }}</strong></p>
            <template v-else>
              <label class="form-label" for="idClient">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL') }}</label>
              <select id="idClient" ref="liste" v-model="idClient" class="form-select">
                <option :value="null">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT') }}</option>
                <option v-for="c in clients" :key="c.id" :value="c.id">{{ libelle(c) }}</option>
              </select>
            </template>
          </div>

          <div class="modal-footer">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" @click="emit('fermer')">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL') }}</button>
            <button ref="boutonConfirmer" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="envoiEnCours">{{ t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM') }}</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </Teleport>
</template>

The appointment booking window. It does not communicate with the server: it sends either [confirmer] with the selected patient, or [fermer]. The calendar page decides what to do with it.

  • lines 22–27: the appointment time, and either the list of patients (ADMIN, DOCTOR) or the name of the logged-in patient (USER);
  • Lines 42–46: Upon opening, the focus goes to the first applicable element (the list of patients or the “Confirm” button); the Esc key closes the window;
  • line 56: a real form: the Enter key confirms;
  • line 66: a patient makes a reservation for themselves: no list.

docs.title: 10.13.1. src/views/ConnexionView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/ConnexionView.vue - la page de connexion (/login)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Même page que views/login.hbs de l'application HTML : login, mot de
  passe, captcha, et un second bouton "Créer un compte client" qui vérifie
  le MÊME captcha avant d'ouvrir la création de compte.

  /login?login=jbernard : le champ login est pré-rempli (juste après la
  création d'un compte).
  /login?redirect=/medecins : après la connexion, on ouvre cette page
  (déposé par le garde du routeur) plutôt que la page d'accueil du rôle.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, reactive, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { ErreurApi } from '../api/client-http';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { useSessionStore } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import ChampCaptcha from '../components/ChampCaptcha.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const router = useRouter();
const session = useSessionStore();
const messages = useMessagesStore();

const saisie = reactive({
  login: typeof route.query.login === 'string' ? route.query.login.slice(0, 30) : '',
  password: '',
  captcha: '',
});
const erreurCaptcha = ref<string | undefined>(undefined);
const envoiEnCours = ref(false);
const champCaptcha = useTemplateRef<InstanceType<typeof ChampCaptcha>>('champCaptcha');
const champLogin = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>('champLogin');
const champPassword = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>('champPassword');

// Focus: on the password if the username is already filled in
onMounted(() => (saisie.login ? champPassword.value : champLogin.value)?.focus());

// both buttons follow this sequence: submit, then, if that fails,
// error message and NOUVELLE image (each is used only once)
async function tenter(action: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  messages.effacer();
  erreurCaptcha.value = undefined;
  envoiEnCours.value = true;
  try {
    await action();
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    if (e instanceof ErreurApi) {
      erreurCaptcha.value = e.champs.captcha;
    }
    await champCaptcha.value?.recharger();
  } finally {
    envoiEnCours.value = false;
  }
}

function seConnecter(): Promise<void> {
  return tenter(async () => {
    await session.connecter(saisie.login.trim(), saisie.password, champCaptcha.value?.captchaId() ?? '', saisie.captcha);
    const redirect = route.query.redirect;
     // only one path, INTERNE: never redirect to another site
    router.push(typeof redirect === 'string' && redirect.startsWith('/') && !redirect.startsWith('//') ? redirect: session.pageAccueil);
  });
}

function creerCompte(): Promise<void> {
  return tenter(async () => {
    await rdvApi.accesInscription(champCaptcha.value?.captchaId() ?? '', saisie.captcha);
    router.push({ name: 'inscription' });
  });
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
      <div class="card p-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ t('LOGIN.TITLE') }}</h5>

        <form @submit.prevent="seConnecter">
          <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ t('LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL') }}</label>
            <input id="login" ref="champLogin" v-model="saisie.login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" required>
          </div>
          <div class="mb-3">
            <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ t('LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL') }}</label>
            <input id="password" ref="champPassword" v-model="saisie.password" type="password" class="form-control"
                   autocomplete="current-password" required>
          </div>

          <ChampCaptcha ref="champCaptcha" v-model="saisie.captcha" :erreur="erreurCaptcha" />

           <!-- type="submit": Entering text in a field triggers "Log In" -->
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100" :disabled="envoiEnCours">{{ t('LOGIN.SUBMIT') }}</button>

           <!-- type="button": This button does not submit the form (no
               contrôle required sur login et mot de passe, inutiles ici) -->
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3" :disabled="envoiEnCours" @click="creerCompte">
            {{ t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT') }}
          </button>
          <div class="form-text text-center">{{ t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP') }}</div>
        </form>

        <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
          {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS') }}
          <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
            <li><code>admin</code> - {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN') }}</li>
            <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR') }}</li>
            <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - {{ t('LOGIN.DEMO_USER') }}</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 32: [/login?login=jbernard] pre-fills the login field (immediately after creating an account);
  • line 38: a reference to COMPOSANT [ChampCaptcha]: we can call what it exposes ([recharger()], [captchaId()]). [InstanceType<typeof ChampCaptcha>] is its type;
  • line 43: the focus is on the password field if the username is already filled in;
  • lines 47–62: both buttons follow the same sequence: submission; if unsuccessful, an error message appears, along with an error below the CAPTCHA field if applicable, and the NOUVELLE image;
  • lines 64–71: the login, followed by the page requested before the login (parameter [redirect], set by the router), or the role’s home page. Only an internal path is accepted: it must begin with [/], but not with [//] ([//site.com/...] refers to a AUTRE site);
  • lines 73–78: “Create a customer account”: the server verifies the CAPTCHA and issues a token; the account creation page then opens;
  • line 105: [type="button"]: this button does not submit the form. In the HTML application, this was a second button for submitting the same form to a different address ([formaction]).

docs.title: 10.13.2. src/views/AgendaView.vue
docs.text:
The main page. As in the HTML and TOUT applications, its state is defined in URL:

/agenda                                             choix du médecin et du jour
/agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05                 l'agenda
/agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05&reserver=7      + la fenêtre de réservation du créneau 7

<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/AgendaView.vue - la page de l'agenda (/agenda)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Trois blocs, comme views/agenda.hbs de l'application HTML :
    1. le choix du médecin et du jour ;
    2. l'agenda de ce médecin ce jour-là ;
    3. la fenêtre de réservation d'un créneau.

  Comme dans l'application HTML, TOUT l'état de la page est dans son URL :
      /agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05             l'agenda
      /agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05&reserver=7  + la fenêtre de réservation
  On peut donc recharger la page, la mettre en favori, utiliser les boutons
  Précédent / Suivant du navigateur. La page SUIT son URL : un watch sur la
  query recharge l'agenda ; les actions de l'utilisateur, elles, changent
  l'URL (router.push).

  Ce que chacun voit et peut faire est décidé par le SERVEUR (champs
  patient, moi, reservable, idRv de chaque créneau) : la page se contente de
  l'afficher. Un patient ne reçoit même pas le nom des autres patients.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, reactive, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { ErreurApi } from '../api/client-http';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Agenda, CreneauAgenda, Personne } from '../api/types';
import { aujourdhui, estUneDateValide, libelle, useFormatage } from '../composables/useFormatage';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useSessionStore } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import FenetreReservation from '../components/FenetreReservation.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const router = useRouter();
const session = useSessionStore();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { horaire, jourLong } = useFormatage();
const { confirmer } = useConfirmation();

const medecins = ref<Personne[]>([]);
const clients = ref<Personne[]>([]); // ADMIN / DOCTOR: for the reservation window
const agenda = ref<Agenda | null>(null);
const chargement = ref(false);
const envoiEnCours = ref(false);

// the values from the “doctor + day” form, copied from URL
const choix = reactive<{ idMedecin: number | null; jour: string }>({ idMedecin: null, jour: aujourdhui() });

// "3" -> 3; "", "abc", "-2", absent -> null
function entierPositif(valeur: unknown): number | null {
  const n = Number(valeur);
  return typeof valeur === 'string' && valeur !== '' && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

// the displayed calendar, without the booking window: the "return" query
const queryAgenda = computed(() => ({ idMedecin: String(choix.idMedecin ?? ''), jour: choix.jour }));

// the time slot with an open booking window (?reserver=7),
// only if it can be booked by this user
const creneauAReserver = computed<CreneauAgenda | null>(() => {
  const id = entierPositif(route.query.reserver);
  return agenda.value?.creneaux.find((c) => c.id === id && c.reservable) ?? null;
});

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Loading
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    medecins.value = await rdvApi.lister('medecins');
     // the list of patients: only for those who have permission to view it
    if (session.estGestionnaire) {
      clients.value = await rdvApi.lister('clients');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
});

// the schedule follows the URL (doctor and day)
watch(() => [route.query.idMedecin, route.query.jour], chargerAgenda, { immediate: true });

async function chargerAgenda(): Promise<void> {
   // the day: the one from URL if valid, otherwise today
  const jourBrut = route.query.jour;
  choix.jour = aujourdhui();
  if (jourBrut !== undefined) {
    if (!estUneDateValide(jourBrut)) {
      agenda.value = null;
      messages.afficherErreur('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE');
      return;
    }
    choix.jour = jourBrut;
  }
   // the doctor: the one from URL; if no doctor is specified, a DOCTOR sees the SON calendar
   // (the server retrieves it from the token)
  choix.idMedecin = entierPositif(route.query.idMedecin);
  if (choix.idMedecin === null && session.role !== 'DOCTOR') {
    agenda.value = null;
    return;
  }
  chargement.value = true;
  try {
    agenda.value = await rdvApi.agenda(choix.idMedecin, choix.jour);
    choix.idMedecin = agenda.value.medecin.id;
  } catch (e) {
    agenda.value = null;
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  } finally {
    chargement.value = false;
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// actions
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------

// "View the calendar": the URL is updated, and the calendar updates accordingly (see "watch" above)
function voirAgenda(): void {
  router.push({ query: queryAgenda.value });
}

function fermerReservation(): void {
  router.push({ query: queryAgenda.value });
}

async function reserver(idClient: number | null): Promise<void> {
  const creneau = creneauAReserver.value;
  if (creneau === null) {
    return;
  }
  envoiEnCours.value = true;
  try {
    await rdvApi.reserver(choix.jour, creneau.id, session.estGestionnaire ? idClient : null);
    messages.flash('succes', 'AGENDA.BOOKED');
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof ErreurApi && e.cle === 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
       // no patient selected: the window remains open
      messages.afficherErreur(e.cle);
      return; // (finally runs anyway)
    }
    if (!(e instanceof ErreurApi)) {
      throw e;
    }
     // slot taken in the meantime, patient already has an appointment...:
     // the message will appear on the calendar; window closed
    messages.flash('erreur', e.cle, e.params);
  } finally {
    envoiEnCours.value = false;
  }
  await router.push({ query: queryAgenda.value });
  await chargerAgenda(); // the server’s record takes precedence: the calendar is re-read
}

async function annuler(c: CreneauAgenda): Promise<void> {
  if (c.idRv === null || !(await confirmer('AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await rdvApi.annulerRv(c.idRv);
    messages.afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
  await chargerAgenda();
}
</script>

<template>
   <!-- 1. Select the doctor and the day -->
  <form class="card p-3 mb-3" @submit.prevent="voirAgenda">
    <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">
      <div class="col-sm-5">
        <label class="form-label" for="idMedecin">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL') }}</label>
        <select id="idMedecin" v-model="choix.idMedecin" class="form-select" required>
          <option :value="null">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR') }}</option>
          <option v-for="m in medecins" :key="m.id" :value="m.id">{{ libelle(m) }}</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-4">
        <label class="form-label" for="jour">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL') }}</label>
        <input id="jour" v-model="choix.jour" type="date" class="form-control" required>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-3">
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{ t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_AGENDA') }}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>

   <!-- Patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button -->
  <div v-if="agenda?.info" class="alert alert-info">
    {{ t(agenda.info) }} <RouterLink to="/mon-espace" class="alert-link">{{ t('APP.MENU_MY_SPACE') }}</RouterLink>
  </div>

   <!-- 2. The calendar -->
  <p v-if="chargement && !agenda" class="text-muted">{{ t('APP.LOADING') }}</p>
  <div v-else-if="agenda" class="card p-3">
    <h5>{{ t('AGENDA.TITLE_PREFIX') }} {{ jourLong(agenda.jour) }} - {{ libelle(agenda.medecin) }}</h5>
    <table v-if="agenda.creneaux.length > 0" class="table table-hover align-middle">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ t('AGENDA.COLUMN_SLOT') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('AGENDA.COLUMN_STATUS') }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="c in agenda.creneaux" :key="c.id" :class="{ 'creneau-libre': c.reservable }">
          <td>{{ horaire(c) }}</td>
          <td>
            <span v-if="c.libre" class="badge text-bg-success">{{ t('AGENDA.FREE') }}</span>
            <span v-else-if="c.patient" class="badge" :class="c.moi ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary'">{{ libelle(c.patient) }}</span>
            <span v-else class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{ t('AGENDA.BOOKED_BY_OTHER') }}</span>
          </td>
          <td class="text-end">
             <!-- "Book" is a LIEN: it adds ?reserver=... to the URL, which
                 ouvre la fenêtre de réservation -->
            <RouterLink v-if="c.reservable" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" :to="{ query: { ...queryAgenda, reserver: c.id } }">
              {{ t('AGENDA.BOOK') }}
            </RouterLink>
            <button v-if="c.idRv !== null" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" @click="annuler(c)">
              {{ t('AGENDA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT') }}
            </button>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p v-else class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t('AGENDA.NO_SLOTS') }}</p>
  </div>
  <p v-else class="text-muted">{{ t('AGENDA.EMPTY_STATE') }}</p>

   <!-- 3. the booking window, only if the URL contains &reserve=... -->
  <FenetreReservation
    v-if="creneauAReserver"
    :horaire="horaire(creneauAReserver)"
    :clients="clients"
    :patient="session.estPatient ? (session.utilisateur?.nom ?? '') : null"
    :envoi-en-cours="envoiEnCours"
    @confirmer="reserver"
    @fermer="fermerReservation"
  />
</template>

Page data:

  • lines 44–48: the lists, the displayed calendar, and the loading and sending indicators;
  • line 51: the values from the “doctor + day” form. They are copied from DEPUIS to URL; the user can modify them without any effect until they click “View Calendar”;
  • line 60: the [query] for the displayed calendar, without a booking window;
  • Lines 64–67: the time slot for which the window is open: [?reserver=...], if it exists, or ET if it is bookable by this user. A manually created URL ([reserver=] on a booked time slot) therefore does not open any booking window.

Loading:

  • Lines 72–82: the list of doctors is visible to everyone, while the list of patients is visible only to those authorized to view it;
  • line 85: the page SUIT is URL. [immediate]: The calendar loads as soon as the page is displayed (a bookmarked URL, a F5); then every time the doctor or the date of the URL changes (by clicking “View Calendar” or the Previous/Next buttons). A change to [reserver] alone does not reload the calendar: it merely opens or closes the window (see [creneauAReserver]);
  • lines 87–116: the day of URL (today by default; an error occurs if it does not exist); the doctor from URL; if no doctor is specified, a logged-in doctor sees the SON calendar (the server retrieves it using the token), and the doctor returned by the server is then copied into the form.

Actions:

  • lines 123–125: “View Calendar” does not load anything itself: it changes the URL, and the calendar updates accordingly;
  • lines 131–157: the appointment:
    • if no patient is selected: the server uses the one from the token;
    • no patient selected (ADMIN, DOCTOR): the window remains open, displaying the message;
    • success or other rejection (slot taken in the meantime, patient already has an appointment): a pop-up message, then URL without [reserver] (the window closes), followed by a reload of the calendar: the server’s version is final;
  • lines 159–170: cancellation, after confirmation. The server returns [idRv] for the time slots the user can cancel: for a ADMIN or a DOCTOR, all of them; for a patient, their own (the HTML application only allowed them to cancel from “My Account”; the API also allows it from the calendar).

The template:

  • line 175: selection of the doctor and the day;
  • line 195: a patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button;
  • line 202: the day, formatted in the current language;
  • lines 216 and 217: the patient’s name, if it was submitted; otherwise, “Booked”;
  • line 222: “Book” is a LIEN: it adds [reserver=...] to the URL. The browser’s Back button therefore closes the window;
  • lines 237–244: the window, when requested by URL.

docs.title: 10.13.3. src/views/personnes.config.ts
docs.text:
The pages for managing doctors and clients are shared. What distinguishes them:

// =========================================================================
// views/personnes.config.ts - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The pages for managing doctors and clients are IDENTIQUES: same
// list, same form. As in the application HTML (abstract class
// PersonnesController), they are written UNE times (PersonnesView.vue,
// PersonneFormulaireView.vue); only the address of the API and the
// label keys, described here. The router specifies the type in the
// meta property of each route (see router.ts).
// =========================================================================

import type { TypePersonnes } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';

export interface ClesPersonnes {
  titre: string; // "Doctors"
  ajouter: string; // "Add a doctor"
  modifier: string; // "Edit a doctor"
  vide: string; // "No doctors."
  confirmerSuppression: string;
  ajoute: string; // "The doctor {name} has been added (login: {login})."
  modifie: string;
  supprime: string;
}

export const CLES_PERSONNES: Record<TypePersonnes, ClesPersonnes> = {
  medecins: {
    titre: 'MEDECINS.TITLE',
    ajouter: 'MEDECINS.ADD',
    modifier: 'MEDECINS.EDIT',
    vide: 'MEDECINS.EMPTY',
    confirmerSuppression: 'MEDECINS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    ajoute: 'MEDECINS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'MEDECINS.UPDATED',
    supprime: 'MEDECINS.DELETED',
  },
  clients: {
    titre: 'CLIENTS.TITLE',
    ajouter: 'CLIENTS.ADD',
    modifier: 'CLIENTS.EDIT',
    vide: 'CLIENTS.EMPTY',
    confirmerSuppression: 'CLIENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    ajoute: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',
    supprime: 'CLIENTS.DELETED',
  },
};

// {name} and {login} "added / edited / deleted" messages
export function parametres(p: { prenom: string; nom: string; login?: string }): Record<string, string> {
  return { nom: `${p.prenom} ${p.nom}`, login: p.login ?? '' };
}
  • line 25: the keys for the labels specific to each type, as in the [MedecinsController] and [ClientsController] controllers of the HTML application;
  • lines 49–51: the parameters [{nom}] and [{login}] for the “added/modified/deleted” messages.

docs.title: 10.13.4. src/views/PersonnesView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/PersonnesView.vue - la liste des médecins OU des clients (ADMIN)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Une seule page pour les deux : le type ('medecins' ou 'clients') est dans
  les métadonnées de la route (route.meta.type, cf. router.ts), les libellés
  propres à chacun dans personnes.config.ts. Équivalent de
  views/personnes/liste.hbs de l'application HTML.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRoute } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi, type TypePersonnes } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Personne } from '../api/types';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import { CLES_PERSONNES, parametres } from './personnes.config';

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { confirmer } = useConfirmation();

const type = route.meta.type as TypePersonnes;
const cles = CLES_PERSONNES[type];
const personnes = ref<Personne[] | null>(null); // null: not yet loaded
const vide = computed(() => personnes.value !== null && personnes.value.length === 0);

async function charger(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    personnes.value = await rdvApi.lister(type);
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
}

async function supprimer(p: Personne): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await confirmer(cles.confirmerSuppression))) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await rdvApi.supprimer(type, p.id);
    messages.afficherSucces(cles.supprime, parametres(p));
  } catch (e) {
     // A doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
  await charger();
}

onMounted(charger);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
    <h4 class="mb-0">{{ t(cles.titre) }}</h4>
    <RouterLink class="btn btn-primary" :to="`/${type}/ajouter`">{{ t(cles.ajouter) }}</RouterLink>
  </div>

  <div class="card p-3">
    <p v-if="personnes === null" class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t('APP.LOADING') }}</p>
    <p v-else-if="vide" class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t(cles.vide) }}</p>
    <table v-else class="table table-hover align-middle mb-0">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_TITLE') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_FIRSTNAME') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_LASTNAME') }}</th>
          <th>{{ t('PERSONNES.COLUMN_LOGIN') }}</th>
          <th></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="p in personnes" :key="p.id">
          <td>{{ p.titre }}</td>
          <td>{{ p.prenom }}</td>
          <td>{{ p.nom }}</td>
          <td><code>{{ p.login }}</code></td>
          <td class="text-end">
            <div class="d-inline-flex gap-2">
              <RouterLink class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" :to="`/${type}/${p.id}/modifier`">{{ t('PERSONNES.EDIT') }}</RouterLink>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" @click="supprimer(p)">{{ t('PERSONNES.DELETE') }}</button>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 26: the type of people, read from the route’s metadata. It will not change during the component’s lifetime: when switching from [/medecins] to [/clients], the key [:key] from [<RouterView>] recreates the page;
  • line 28: [null] as long as the list has not been loaded: this distinguishes between “loading” and “empty list”;
  • lines 39–51: confirmation, deletion, message, and reloading of the list. If a doctor still has appointments: the server returns a 409 response, and the message is displayed at the bottom of the page.

docs.title: 10.13.5. src/views/PersonneFormulaireView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/PersonneFormulaireView.vue - création OU modification d'un médecin
  ou d'un client (ADMIN)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    /medecins/ajouter          -> création (pas de prop id)
    /medecins/3/modifier       -> modification (prop id = 3, cf. router.ts)
  (et les mêmes adresses sous /clients). Équivalent de
  views/personnes/formulaire.hbs de l'application HTML.

  Aucune règle n'est vérifiée ici : le serveur valide tout, et ses erreurs
  s'affichent sous les champs (cf. composables/useFormulaire.ts).
  La VERSION lue avec la fiche repart avec la modification : si un autre
  ADMIN l'a modifiée entre-temps, le serveur répond 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, reactive } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { ErreurApi } from '../api/client-http';
import { rdvApi, type TypePersonnes } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { DonneesPersonne } from '../api/types';
import { useFormulaire } from '../composables/useFormulaire';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import ChampsPersonne from '../components/ChampsPersonne.vue';
import ChampSaisie from '../components/ChampSaisie.vue';
import { CLES_PERSONNES, parametres } from './personnes.config';

const props = defineProps<{ id?: number }>();

const { t } = useI18n();
const route = useRoute();
const router = useRouter();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { erreurs, params, envoiEnCours, envoyer } = useFormulaire();

const type = route.meta.type as TypePersonnes;
const cles = CLES_PERSONNES[type];
const creation = computed(() => props.id === undefined);

const saisie = reactive<DonneesPersonne>({ titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '', version: undefined });

// modification: the record is being read (including its version)
onMounted(async () => {
  if (props.id === undefined) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    const p = await rdvApi.lire(type, props.id);
    Object.assign(saisie, { titre: p.titre, prenom: p.prenom, nom: p.nom, login: p.login ?? '', version: p.version });
  } catch (e) {
     // record does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): return to the list
    if (e instanceof ErreurApi) {
      messages.flash('erreur', e.cle, e.params);
      router.push(`/${type}`);
      return;
    }
    throw e;
  }
});

async function enregistrer(): Promise<void> {
  const reussi = await envoyer(async () => {
    const p = props.id === undefined ? await rdvApi.ajouter(type, saisie) : await rdvApi.modifier(type, props.id, saisie);
    messages.flash('succes', creation.value ? cles.ajoute : cles.modifie, parametres(p));
  });
  if (reussi) {
    router.push(`/${type}`);
  } else if (messages.erreur?.cle === 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND' || messages.erreur?.cle === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND') {
     // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: return to the list
    messages.flash('erreur', messages.erreur.cle);
    router.push(`/${type}`);
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
      <div class="card p-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ t(creation ? cles.ajouter : cles.modifier) }}</h5>
         <!-- not validated: the SERVEUR validates it (it is the authoritative record) -->
        <form novalidate @submit.prevent="enregistrer">
          <ChampsPersonne v-model:titre="saisie.titre" v-model:prenom="saisie.prenom" v-model:nom="saisie.nom" :erreurs="erreurs" />

          <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION') }}</h6>
          <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.login" class="mb-3" id="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" :maxlength="30"
                       :erreur="erreurs.login" :aide="creation ? 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT'" />
           <!-- never pre-filled: the password is never returned from the server -->
          <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.password" class="mb-4" id="password" type="password" libelle="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL"
                       :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" :erreur="erreurs.password" :params="params"
                       :aide="creation ? 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT'" />

          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="envoiEnCours">{{ t('PERSONNES.SAVE') }}</button>
            <RouterLink class="btn btn-secondary" :to="`/${type}`">{{ t('PERSONNES.BACK') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 30: creation without [id], modification with it (the property comes from the route; see [router.ts]);
  • line 36: form errors (see [useFormulaire.ts]);
  • lines 45–61: during modification, read the record, including the version. If it does not exist (deleted in the meantime), return to the list with a message;
  • lines 63–75: POST or PUT; if successful, display a message and return to the list. If the operation fails, [useFormulaire] has already displayed the errors; if a record has been deleted in the meantime, the program returns to the list;
  • line 84: [novalidate]: the server validates this;
  • line 85: the three named [v-model] commands;
  • line 91: the password is never pre-filled: it is never returned from the server.

docs.title: 10.13.6. src/views/InscriptionView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/InscriptionView.vue - "Créer un compte client" (/inscription, public)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  On n'arrive ici qu'après avoir recopié le captcha de la page de connexion
  (bouton "Créer un compte client") : le serveur a alors délivré un
  laissez-passer, que le garde de la route a vérifié (cf. router.ts).
  Mêmes champs que le formulaire de l'ADMIN, mais le login et le mot de
  passe sont obligatoires, avec confirmation. Équivalent de
  views/compte/inscription.hbs de l'application HTML.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { Inscription } from '../api/types';
import { useFormulaire } from '../composables/useFormulaire';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import ChampsPersonne from '../components/ChampsPersonne.vue';
import ChampSaisie from '../components/ChampSaisie.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const router = useRouter();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { erreurs, params, envoiEnCours, envoyer } = useFormulaire();

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also returns {min} with the error PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT)
const MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN = '6';

const saisie = reactive<Inscription>({ titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '', confirmation: '' });

async function creer(): Promise<void> {
  let login = '';
  const reussi = await envoyer(async () => {
    login = (await rdvApi.inscrire(saisie)).login;
  });
  if (reussi) {
     // return to the login page, login pre-filled
    messages.flash('succes', 'INSCRIPTION.DONE', { login });
    router.push({ name: 'login', query: { login } });
  } else if (messages.erreur?.cle === 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
     // pass expired (15 minutes): return to CAPTCHA
    messages.flash('erreur', 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
    router.push({ name: 'login' });
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
      <div class="card p-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-1">{{ t('INSCRIPTION.TITLE') }}</h5>
        <p class="text-muted small mb-3">{{ t('INSCRIPTION.INTRO') }}</p>
        <form novalidate @submit.prevent="creer">
          <ChampsPersonne v-model:titre="saisie.titre" v-model:prenom="saisie.prenom" v-model:nom="saisie.nom" :erreurs="erreurs" />

          <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION') }}</h6>
          <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.login" class="mb-3" id="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" :maxlength="30"
                       autocomplete="username" requis :erreur="erreurs.login" aide="INSCRIPTION.LOGIN_HELP" />
          <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
            <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.password" class="col-sm-6" id="password" type="password" libelle="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL"
                         :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" requis :erreur="erreurs.password"
                         :params="{ min: MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN, ...params }" aide="INSCRIPTION.PASSWORD_HELP" />
            <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.confirmation" class="col-sm-6" id="confirmation" type="password"
                         libelle="COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" requis
                         :erreur="erreurs.confirmation" />
          </div>
          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="envoiEnCours">{{ t('INSCRIPTION.SUBMIT') }}</button>
            <RouterLink class="btn btn-secondary" to="/login">{{ t('INSCRIPTION.BACK_TO_LOGIN') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • line 31: the minimum password length, for the help message (the server also returns this in [params], along with the error);
  • lines 35–49: account creation, followed by the login page with the username pre-filled. If the token has expired (15 minutes), the server responds with a 403 error: return to the login page to solve a new CAPTCHA;
  • line 67: the message parameters for the field; [...params] (the parsing operator) copies those returned by the server.

Access to this page is controlled by the [beforeEnter] guard on its route (see [router.ts]).

docs.title: 10.13.7. src/views/EspacePatientView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/EspacePatientView.vue - "Mon espace" (/mon-espace, rôle USER)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  La page d'accueil du patient, juste après sa connexion :
    - deux options : [Gérer mon compte] et [Voir un agenda] ;
    - son rendez-vous à venir, s'il en a un, avec le moyen de l'annuler.
  Équivalent de views/patient/espace.hbs de l'application HTML.
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { MonEspace } from '../api/types';
import { useFormatage } from '../composables/useFormatage';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';

const { t } = useI18n();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { libelle, horaire, jourLong } = useFormatage();
const { confirmer } = useConfirmation();

const espace = ref<MonEspace | null>(null);

async function charger(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    espace.value = await rdvApi.monEspace();
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
}

async function annuler(idRv: number): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await confirmer('AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
    return;
  }
  try {
    await rdvApi.annulerRv(idRv);
    messages.afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
  await charger();
}

onMounted(charger);
</script>

<template>
  <template v-if="espace">
    <h4 class="mb-3">{{ t('ESPACE.HELLO', { nom: libelle(espace.patient) }) }}</h4>
    <div class="row g-3 mb-4">
      <div class="col-sm-6">
        <RouterLink class="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none carte-option" to="/mon-compte">
          <h5 class="mb-1">{{ t('ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT') }}</h5>
          <span class="text-muted">{{ t('ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP') }}</span>
        </RouterLink>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-6">
        <RouterLink class="card p-4 h-100 text-decoration-none carte-option" to="/agenda">
          <h5 class="mb-1">{{ t('ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA') }}</h5>
          <span class="text-muted">{{ t('ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA_HELP') }}</span>
        </RouterLink>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card p-3">
      <h5>{{ t('ESPACE.MY_APPOINTMENT') }}</h5>
       <!-- normally only one (rule: “one upcoming appointment at a time”),
           mais la page sait en afficher plusieurs -->
      <div
        v-for="(rv, i) in espace.rendezVous"
        :key="rv.id"
        class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 py-2"
        :class="{ 'border-bottom': i < espace.rendezVous.length - 1 }"
      >
        <div>
          <div class="fw-semibold">{{ jourLong(rv.jour) }}, {{ horaire(rv.creneau) }}</div>
          <div class="text-muted">
            {{ libelle(rv.medecin) }} -
             <!-- the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there -->
            <RouterLink :to="{ path: '/agenda', query: { idMedecin: rv.medecin.id, jour: rv.jour } }">{{ t('ESPACE.SEE_IN_AGENDA') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger" @click="annuler(rv.id)">{{ t('ESPACE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT') }}</button>
      </div>
      <p v-if="espace.rendezVous.length === 0" class="text-muted mb-0">{{ t('ESPACE.NO_APPOINTMENT') }}</p>
    </div>
  </template>
  <p v-else class="text-muted">{{ t('APP.LOADING') }}</p>
</template>
  • lines 36–47: the patient cancels the SON appointment (the server would reject one from someone else);
  • line 57: an entire card is a link;
  • line 75: normally only one appointment (the “one upcoming appointment at a time” rule), but the page can display multiple ones;
  • line 85: the doctor’s schedule for that day, where the patient sees their name.

docs.title: 10.13.8. src/views/MonCompteView.vue
docs.text:
<!--
  =========================================================================
  views/MonCompteView.vue - "Gérer mon compte" (/mon-compte, rôle USER)
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Deux formulaires indépendants, comme views/patient/compte.hbs :
    1. la modification (identité, login, nouveau mot de passe facultatif) ;
    2. la suppression du compte - qui annule aussi ses rendez-vous.
  L'un comme l'autre exigent le mot de passe ACTUEL (vérifié par le serveur).
  =========================================================================
-->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { rdvApi } from '../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import type { ModificationMonCompte } from '../api/types';
import { useFormulaire } from '../composables/useFormulaire';
import { useConfirmation } from '../composables/useConfirmation';
import { useSessionStore } from '../stores/session';
import { useMessagesStore } from '../stores/messages';
import ChampsPersonne from '../components/ChampsPersonne.vue';
import ChampSaisie from '../components/ChampSaisie.vue';

const { t } = useI18n();
const router = useRouter();
const session = useSessionStore();
const messages = useMessagesStore();
const { confirmer } = useConfirmation();
// two forms, so two sets of errors
const modification = useFormulaire();
const suppression = useFormulaire();

const saisie = reactive<ModificationMonCompte>({
  titre: 'Mr',
  prenom: '',
  nom: '',
  login: '',
  password: '',
  confirmation: '',
  motDePasseActuel: '',
  version: 0,
});
const motDePasseSuppression = ref('');

onMounted(async () => {
  try {
    Object.assign(saisie, await rdvApi.monCompte());
  } catch (e) {
    messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
  }
});

async function enregistrer(): Promise<void> {
  const reussi = await modification.envoyer(async () => {
     // the server issued a NOUVEAU token (name, login): the
     // must follow
    session.mettreAJour(await rdvApi.modifierMonCompte(saisie));
    messages.flash('succes', 'MON_COMPTE.UPDATED');
  });
   // Never leave a password in the fields after submitting
  saisie.motDePasseActuel = '';
  if (reussi) {
    router.push('/mon-espace');
  }
}

async function supprimer(): Promise<void> {
  if (!(await confirmer('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_CONFIRM'))) {
    return;
  }
  const reussi = await suppression.envoyer(async () => {
    await rdvApi.supprimerMonCompte(motDePasseSuppression.value);
  });
  motDePasseSuppression.value = '';
  if (reussi) {
    session.oublier(); // The server deleted the token cookie
    messages.flash('succes', 'MON_COMPTE.DELETED');
    router.push({ name: 'login' });
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="row justify-content-center">
    <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
       <!-- 1. Modification -->
      <div class="card p-4 mb-4">
        <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ t('MON_COMPTE.TITLE') }}</h5>
        <form novalidate @submit.prevent="enregistrer">
          <ChampsPersonne v-model:titre="saisie.titre" v-model:prenom="saisie.prenom" v-model:nom="saisie.nom" :erreurs="modification.erreurs.value" />

          <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION') }}</h6>
          <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.login" class="mb-3" id="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" :maxlength="30"
                       autocomplete="username" requis :erreur="modification.erreurs.value.login" />
          <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
            <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.password" class="col-sm-6" id="password" type="password" libelle="MON_COMPTE.NEW_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                         :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" :erreur="modification.erreurs.value.password"
                         :params="modification.params.value" aide="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT" />
            <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.confirmation" class="col-sm-6" id="confirmation" type="password"
                         libelle="COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password"
                         :erreur="modification.erreurs.value.confirmation" />
          </div>
          <ChampSaisie v-model="saisie.motDePasseActuel" class="mb-4" id="motDePasseActuel" type="password"
                       libelle="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="current-password" requis
                       :erreur="modification.erreurs.value.motDePasseActuel" aide="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_HELP" />
          <div class="d-flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" :disabled="modification.envoiEnCours.value">{{ t('PERSONNES.SAVE') }}</button>
            <RouterLink class="btn btn-secondary" to="/mon-espace">{{ t('MON_COMPTE.BACK') }}</RouterLink>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>

       <!-- 2. Deletion -->
      <div class="card p-4 border-danger">
        <h5 class="card-title text-danger mb-1">{{ t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_TITLE') }}</h5>
        <p class="text-muted small">{{ t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_HELP') }}</p>
        <form class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 align-items-end" novalidate @submit.prevent="supprimer">
          <ChampSaisie v-model="motDePasseSuppression" class="flex-grow-1" id="motDePasseSuppression" type="password"
                       libelle="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL" :maxlength="72" autocomplete="current-password" requis
                       :erreur="suppression.erreurs.value.motDePasseActuel" />
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-danger" :disabled="suppression.envoiEnCours.value">{{ t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_SUBMIT') }}</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
  • lines 30–31: two forms, so two sets of errors: a composable can be called as many times as desired, and each call has its own state;
  • line 47: the values read are copied into the form, including the version;
  • lines 53–65: the server has issued a new token (the name and login may have changed); it returns the user as described by this token, and the session is updated: the navigation bar follows suit. The current password is cleared after each submission;
  • lines 67–80: confirmation, deletion; the server has deleted the token cookie: the user is forgotten, and the user is redirected back to the login page;
  • line 90: [modification] is a regular object that is a child of CONTIENT, which is a child of [ref]: in the template, you must write [.value] (see Example 11).
